name: Kiribi
description: Kiribi was a planet located in the Colonies. Its galactic coordinates were 099, 099, 011. Although it was located 5000 light-years away from Coruscant, because Kiribi's coordinates were positive and began with zero, it was part of the Imperial Center Oversector during the Imperial Period.
